specs.qlinks: 4 Touch-Capacitive Q-Link Knobs (4 Banks via Q-Link button = 16 parameters)
specs.cpu: Quad-Core ARM Processor (Rockchip RK3288/RK3399 Linux RT)
specs.ram: 2 GB RAM (4 GB Internal OS Storage - Always save to SD/USB!)
specs.network: 1x RJ45 Ethernet Port + USB Tethering (No built-in Wi-Fi/Bluetooth unlike MPC One+)
specs.io_audio: 2x 1/4" TRS Balanced Inputs, 2x 1/4" TRS Balanced Outputs, 1x 1/8" Stereo Headphone Out
specs.io_midi_cv: 5-Pin MIDI In / MIDI Out, 4x TRS 1/8" CV/Gate Jacks (8 Outputs total via TRS splitters)
specs.storage_slots: Front SD Card Slot (SDHC/SDXC), 1x USB-A 3.0 Host Port (for Flash drives, MIDI controllers, or USB Mouse in 3.10.1), 1x USB-B Port
